label.disc_crafting.name: Disc name
hint.disc_crafting.import: "Import audio file" opens your system's file picker; you can also drag an audio file into this window.
hint.disc_crafting.studio: The disc goes straight into your inventory
hint.disc_crafting.language: Switches instantly; only affects this mod's screens, item names and tooltips.
hint.disc_crafting.no_seek: Audio file missing for this track, so the bar is read-only
hint.disc_crafting.walkman_entity: Only affects this walkman; "Edit list" turns on list play
hint.disc_crafting.walkman_handheld: Hold a disc, press N to play/pause; "Edit list" turns on list play
message.disc_crafting.picker_opening: System file picker opened - check the taskbar if you don't see it
message.disc_crafting.picker_headless: The system file picker could not open (%s). You can drag the audio file into this window instead.
message.disc_crafting.picker_no_tool: The system file picker could not open (%s). Install zenity or kdialog, or just drag the audio file into this window.
message.disc_crafting.picker_failed: The system file picker could not open (%s). You can drag the audio file into this window instead.
message.disc_crafting.select_track_first: Pick a track on the right first
message.disc_crafting.need_disc: Your other hand needs a disc (an empty hand works too)
message.disc_crafting.missing_audio: This track's audio is not on this computer
message.disc_crafting.missing_song: This vanilla record cannot be played here
message.disc_crafting.need_empty_disc: Hold a blank disc to craft
tooltip.disc_crafting.empty_disc: Hold one while making a disc
tooltip.disc_crafting.walkman.play: Hold a disc (custom or vanilla) in the other hand, press N to play/pause
tooltip.disc_crafting.walkman.place: Right-click a block to place it (never into water); standing + jukebox inserts the disc, crouching puts the walkman on top; placing with an empty other hand copies this one's track and settings
tooltip.disc_crafting.walkman.volume: Press B for the walkman controls (seek, repeat, volume, list play)
hint.disc_crafting.playlist: Click a track on the left to add it, on the right to remove it; the buttons below change order and toggle list play
hint.disc_crafting.playlist_empty: The playlist is empty - click a track on the left to add it
hint.disc_crafting.playlist_empty_short: List is empty - open "Edit list" to add tracks
message.disc_crafting.playlist_on: List playback enabled - the current track keeps playing
message.disc_crafting.playlist_off: List playback disabled - the current track plays out
message.disc_crafting.no_water: The walkman cannot be placed in water
hint.disc_crafting.underwater: 100% is the default muffle; lower keeps more treble, 0% means no effect, 300% is the max. Turning the switch off plays everything dry.
message.disc_crafting.track_inherited: Inherited the track playing on your walkman
tooltip.disc_crafting.walkman.inherit: Placing it hands its playlist over to the placed walkman; with an empty other hand the current track comes along too
